g.text: mcu-pico: a Pico 2 / Pico Plus 2 on pin sockets, USB at the board's edge. +12V -> 5V reg -> +5V -> D1 -> VSYS; 3V3 OUT = +3V3

g.desc: mcu-pico: a Pico 2 / Pico Plus 2 on pin sockets, USB at the board's edge. +12V -> 5V reg -> +5V -> D1 -> VSYS; 3V3 OUT = +3V3

g.text: I2S out through 33R: BCK GP18, LRCK GP19, DOUT GP20, MCLK GP22 (256 fs); DIN GP21. CV1, CV2 on ADC0, ADC1.

g.desc: I2S out through 33R: BCK GP18, LRCK GP19, DOUT GP20, MCLK GP22 (256 fs); DIN GP21. CV1, CV2 on ADC0, ADC1.

g.text: Pots: mux (select GP10-12) into ADC2 (GP28); J1 TIME, J2 FDBK, J3 MIX = JST PH (1 GND, 2 wiper, 3 +3V3). CV3, CV4 on A3, A4; A5-A7 to EXP.

g.desc: Pots: mux (select GP10-12) into ADC2 (GP28); J1 TIME, J2 FDBK, J3 MIX = JST PH (1 GND, 2 wiper, 3 +3V3). CV3, CV4 on A3, A4; A5-A7 to EXP.

g.text: Gates (D62): GATE1 GP16, GATE2 GP17 in, GATE_OUT GP9 (gate-io-direct). J6 EXP (2x8, pads only): GP0-GP8, mux A5-A7, +5V, +3V3, GND.

g.desc: Gates (D62): GATE1 GP16, GATE2 GP17 in, GATE_OUT GP9 (gate-io-direct). J6 EXP (2x8, pads only): GP0-GP8, mux A5-A7, +5V, +3V3, GND.

g.text: J4 ALGO button (1 signal, 2 GND) on GP13, 10k pull-up. D2 ALGO LED from GP14 (2.2k); J5 pads for a panel LED (470R). XSMT GP15.
